reading.title: Look Around Our Classroom
reading.purpose: Hear where things are in a classroom.
paras: Look at our classroom. The fish tank sits beside the window. A basket is under the table. Inside the basket are three books.
The rug is between the shelf and the door. Behind the rug, the cubbies hold our coats.

qs.why: The reading says inside the basket are three books.

qs.q: The rug is between the shelf and the door. Where is the rug?
choices: In the middle of the two.
At the back of the two.
qs.why: Between means in the middle of two things.
The cubbies hold our coats, and they are behind the rug.

reading.retellFrame: In our classroom, a ___ is under the ___.
